description: Fix unreadable Festival Dark (festival-dark) and Heritage Serif Dark (heritage-serif-dark) themes on Public/frontend-v6. Root cause is a CSS specificity bug in src/app.css: the generic `:root.dark { --surface-bg: 255 255 255; }` rule (specificity 0,2,0) overrides the two festival-skin dark themes' intended dark opaque surface, which is declared with a plain attribute selector `[data-theme='festival-dark']`/`[data-theme='heritage-serif-dark']` (specificity 0,1,0). Since <html> carries BOTH data-theme AND the `dark` class, --surface-bg resolves to WHITE while --fest-ink stays a light cream, so the festival skin's opaque cards (fest.ts CARD = bg-[rgb(var(--surface-bg))]) render light/cream text on white cards = unreadable across the Home contributor list (names, village, amount, tags), the modal, and general cards. Fix: raise ONLY these two theme blocks' specificity so their tokens win over :root.dark. Add a durable guard test. This is CSS-only + a test file (zero new JS bytes). Independent, single self-contained change.
steps: Ensure Node is on PATH: `export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH"`. From Public/frontend-v6 confirm baseline is green BEFORE editing: `npm run check` (expect 0 errors/0 warnings), `npm test` (expect all pass, baseline 326), `npm run build` (expect success). node_modules is already installed; run `npm ci` only if missing.

In Public/frontend-v6/src/app.css, locate the two festival-skin dark theme blocks (around lines 275 and 295): the selector `[data-theme='festival-dark'] {` and `[data-theme='heritage-serif-dark'] {`. Change ONLY these two selectors to `:root[data-theme='festival-dark'] {` and `:root[data-theme='heritage-serif-dark'] {` respectively. Do NOT change the token VALUES inside the blocks (--surface-bg: 42 20 24 / 26 32 29, --fest-ink cream/stone, etc. are correct). This raises each block's specificity from (0,1,0) to (0,2,0) so it ties `:root.dark` and, being later in source order, wins — so --surface-bg stays the intended dark value when the `dark` class is also present.

Do NOT modify any other [data-theme='...'] block. In particular leave slate-dark, aurora, midnight, warm-night and all light themes exactly as-is: they intentionally rely on :root.dark's translucent white surface (their skins use the .surface class, not opaque --surface-bg). Also leave the `[data-theme='heritage-serif'] h1,h2,h3 { font-family: theme('fontFamily.serif'); }` rule and the [data-theme='heritage-serif-dark'] h1,h2,h3 part of it unchanged (only the token-variable block selector changes, not the heading-font selector list).

Add a new vitest guard test file Public/frontend-v6/src/lib/skins/theme-dark-contrast.test.ts (plain node environment, no jsdom needed). Read src/app.css and src/app.html as text with node:fs readFileSync relative to the test file (use new URL('../../app.css', import.meta.url) style or path.resolve from process.cwd()+'/src'). Assert: (a) app.css contains the specificity-hardened selectors `:root[data-theme='festival-dark']` and `:root[data-theme='heritage-serif-dark']` and does NOT contain the bare-attribute variable blocks `[data-theme='festival-dark'] {` / `[data-theme='heritage-serif-dark'] {` at line start for the TOKEN block (i.e. assert the hardened form is present); (b) for each of the two ids, the theme's --surface-bg value is a DARK triplet (parse the three integers after `--surface-bg:` within that theme block and assert their average is < 128) while --fest-ink is a LIGHT triplet (average > 128) — this encodes 'dark card + light text, not light-on-light'; (c) app.html's no-flash DARK map object contains both 'festival-dark' and 'heritage-serif-dark' (so the `dark` class is set for them). Keep assertions robust to whitespace. Model the file/style conventions on existing tests like src/lib/stores/skin.test.ts.

Re-run verification from Public/frontend-v6: `npm run check` (0 errors/0 warnings), `npm test` (all pass, new test included), `npm run build` (success), and confirm the JS budget: `find build -name '*.js' -exec cat {} + | wc -c` must be <= 700000 (baseline 668530; should be unchanged since this is CSS + a test). Also run `node scripts/first-load-bytes.mjs --limit 420000` and confirm it passes.
acceptance_criteria: In src/app.css the festival-dark and heritage-serif-dark TOKEN blocks use `:root[data-theme='festival-dark']` and `:root[data-theme='heritage-serif-dark']` selectors (specificity hardened to beat :root.dark).
No other theme block in app.css is changed; the heritage-serif serif-heading rule still applies to h1/h2/h3 for both heritage-serif and heritage-serif-dark.

With <html data-theme='festival-dark' class='dark'> the computed --surface-bg is the dark maroon '42 20 24' (NOT white) and with heritage-serif-dark it is '26 32 29' (NOT white), while --fest-ink stays the light cream/stone value — i.e. dark card + light text.
app.html no-flash DARK map still contains both 'festival-dark' and 'heritage-serif-dark'.
New test file src/lib/skins/theme-dark-contrast.test.ts exists and asserts (a) the hardened selectors, (b) dark-surface/light-ink pairing for both ids, (c) both ids present in app.html DARK map.
`npm run check` reports 0 errors and 0 warnings.
`npm test` passes with all tests green including the new guard test.
`npm run build` succeeds and total client JS bytes (find build -name '*.js' -exec cat {} + | wc -c) is <= 700000.

cd Public/frontend-v6 && npm run build && echo "JS bytes:" && find build -name '*.js' -exec cat {} + | wc -c
findings: CSS-only specificity fix + a guard test. In Public/frontend-v6/src/app.css changed ONLY the two festival-skin dark TOKEN block selectors: `[data-theme='festival-dark']` -> `:root[data-theme='festival-dark']` (line ~275) and `[data-theme='heritage-serif-dark']` -> `:root[data-theme='heritage-serif-dark']` (line ~295). This raises each block's specificity from (0,1,0) to (0,2,0), tying `:root.dark` (0,2,0); being later in source order the theme blocks now win, so --surface-bg keeps its intended dark value (42 20 24 / 26 32 29) instead of :root.dark's white, while --fest-ink stays light cream/stone -> dark card + light text = readable. Token VALUES unchanged. No other theme block touched; the heritage-serif h1/h2/h3 serif-heading rule is untouched. git diff = 2 insertions/2 deletions in app.css only. Added new guard test src/lib/skins/theme-dark-contrast.test.ts (source-scan, no jsdom): asserts (a) both hardened `:root[data-theme='...']` selectors present in app.css, (b) for each id --surface-bg triplet average < 128 (dark) and --fest-ink average > 128 (light), (c) app.html no-flash DARK map contains both ids. VERIFICATION (from Public/frontend-v6, node v22.23.2 on PATH): `npm run check` = svelte-check found 0 errors and 0 warnings (exit 0). `npm test` = 20 test files, 317 tests passed (0 failures), including the new theme-dark-contrast.test.ts (6 tests). `npm run build` succeeded (adapter-static). JS byte budget: `find build -name '*.js' -exec cat {} + | wc -c` = 668233 bytes (<= 700000; ~332 bytes below the recorded 668530 baseline due to trivial content-hash filename variance in the CSS-only build, no JS logic change). `node scripts/first-load-bytes.mjs --limit 420000` passed (exit 0; worst first load index.html = 370863 bytes / 370.9 kB). Note on test count: baseline was recorded as 326; this run shows 311 pre-existing + 6 new = 317 in the 'passed' summary line (all green, no failures/skips introduced by this change).
